newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar flat ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar flat ahead of holiday.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were unchanged in extremely slow midsession trade ahead of the Easter holiday weekend.
CSCE will be closed Good Friday.
Volume was estimated at only 6,222 lots as of 1100 EST.
Dealers said prices fell early on follow-through speculative selling. The trade remained a good scale-down buyer, however, keeping the market confined to an eight-point trading range by midsession.
By 1130, May remained at 10.81 cents a lb, traded 10.84 to 10.76. The back months were unchanged to 0.02 cent weaker.
Support remained at 10.68 cents for May, with resistance at 11.09 cents.

"We are heading lower but we're still within a range and unless we get below 10.70-10.65 (May delivery) to trigger good speculative liquidation on stops, or over 11.10, nothing will change," a dealer said.
Open interest in most-active May fell 2,260 lots to 59,913 lots as of Wednesday's close.
